SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_joined
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'
AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_member_ids
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'

SELECT 
  join_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date >= '2026-10-01' AND join_date <= '2026-10-05'
GROUP BY join_date
ORDER BY join_date

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'
